OUTPUT.description: Folder that render and apply write the harness files to.

OSF_DATA.description: State folder: apply records the applied version here and plan compares with it.

FACTORY_MCP_REGISTRY.description: Base URL of the MCP Registry that plan reads to pin registry servers in factory.lock.

FACTORY_FORGE_URL.description: Base URL of the Forgejo forge that holds the webhooks of forgejo automations, for example https://code.example.org.

FACTORY_FORGE_TOKEN.description: Forgejo API token that may manage the webhooks of the agents' repositories.

FACTORY_FORGEJO_ADAPTER.description: Command line of the forge port's forgejo adapter, which manages the webhooks of forgejo automations.

FACTORY_GITHUB_URL.description: Base URL of GitHub's REST API for the webhooks of github automations; GitHub Enterprise Server is https://<host>/api/v3.

FACTORY_GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub token that may manage the webhooks of the agents' repositories, for github automations.

FACTORY_GITHUB_ADAPTER.description: Command line of the forge port's github adapter, which manages the webhooks of github automations.

FACTORY_INTAKE_URL.description: The address that receives the webhooks of forgejo and github automations, usually intake.

FACTORY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: The secret that signs the deliveries of the webhooks apply registers; intake checks it.

FACTORY_INFERENCE_URL.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible inference gateway that the kagent ModelConfig of render --k8s points at.
